rules.sentence: Bursitis, or painful bursa swelling from noxious stimuli, occurs commonly in areas with bony protuberances like the subacromial and trochanteric bursae.
Septic ulnar bursitis often results from the spread of pyogenic flexor tenosynovitis, which originates from the digital flexor tendon sheaths communicating with the ulnar bursa.
Septic bursitis complicating invasive hand and wrist procedures is mainly associated with Staphylococcus aureusinfection.
